ctx.x: Symphony, the guys - Knapp /has a great big school out there and his son is carrying it on. But they had to come to Walter Bishop to learn how to play these vibraphone, chimes, glockenspiels and what have you.

You know I've been teaching in a couple of music schools in a couple of places. I taught a course up at the University of Maryland and a very great young drummer, modern drummer today that loved you dearly and speaks so highly of you is Aldn Dawson. He taught a course up there showing young drummers the procedure and where it came from. He gave you so much credit for the sock cymbal and the great brush work that you did, that nobody was doing before you. You know of Aldn Dawson, do you?
